defmodule CrossAuth.TokenVerifier do @moduledoc """ Cross-service authentication token verifier. Validates tokens issued by partner services and generates session descriptors for the local SSI-based template engine. """ require Logger @hmac_algorithm :sha256 @token_ttl_seconds 300 @allowed_services ["billing", "analytics", "notifications"] defstruct [:service_name, :user_id, :roles, :metadata, :issued_at] def verify_and_create_session(token, shared_secret) do with {:ok, payload} <- decode_token(token, shared_secret), {:ok, claims} <- validate_claims(payload), {:ok, session} <- build_session_descriptor(claims) do {:ok, session} else {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason} end end defp decode_token(token, secret) do case String.split(token, ".", parts: 3) do [encoded_header, encoded_payload, signature] -> expected_sig = compute_signature(encoded_header, encoded_payload, secret) if secure_compare(signature, expected_sig) do {:ok, decode_payload(encoded_payload)} else {:error, :invalid_signature} end _ -> {:error, :malformed_token} end end defp compute_signature(header, payload, secret) do data = header <> "." <> payload :crypto.mac(:hmac, @hmac_algorithm, secret, data) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false) end defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do :crypto.hash_equals(a, b) end defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false defp decode_payload(encoded) do case Base.url_decode64(encoded, padding: false) do {:ok, json} -> Jason.decode!(json) :error -> %{} end end defp validate_claims(payload) do with {:ok, service} <- validate_service(payload["service"]), {:ok, _} <- validate_timestamp(payload["iat"]), {:ok, user_id} <- validate_user_id(payload["sub"]) do {:ok, %{ service: service, user_id: user_id, roles: payload["roles"] || [], metadata: payload["metadata"] || %{}, display_name: payload["display_name"] || "anonymous" }} end end defp validate_service(name) when name in @allowed_services, do: {:ok, name} defp validate_service(_), do: {:error, :unknown_service} defp validate_timestamp(iat) when is_integer(iat) do now = System.system_time(:second) if now - iat <= @token_ttl_seconds, do: {:ok, iat}, else: {:error, :token_expired} end defp validate_timestamp(_), do: {:error, :invalid_timestamp} defp validate_user_id(id) when is_binary(id) and byte_size(id) > 0, do: {:ok, id} defp validate_user_id(_), do: {:error, :invalid_user_id} defp build_session_descriptor(claims) do descriptor = format_session_include(claims) {:ok, %{descriptor: descriptor, claims: claims}} end defp format_session_include(claims) do # Generate SSI directive for the template engine to include # user-specific session fragment service = claims.service # user_id is user-controlled and flows into a live SSI directive path, # so it must be restricted to a safe path-segment character set to # prevent breaking out of the virtual="..." attribute / directive. user_id = sanitize_path_segment(claims.user_id) display = sanitize_ssi_content(claims.display_name) # The session include path incorporates sanitized values # for personalized greeting fragments served by the template engine include_path = "/sessions/#{service}/#{user_id}/greeting" # Build the SSI directive that the web server will process "" end defp sanitize_path_segment(text) do text |> String.replace(~r/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/, "") |> String.slice(0, 64) end defp sanitize_ssi_content(text) do text |> String.replace(~r//, "") |> String.replace(~r/#/, "") |> String.slice(0, 64) end end defmodule CrossAuth.SessionRenderer do @moduledoc """ Renders session descriptors into HTTP responses. The output is served through an nginx/Apache frontend that processes SSI directives before sending to client. """ def render_authenticated_page(session, template) do body = String.replace(template, "{{SESSION_BLOCK}}", session.descriptor) {:ok, body} end def render_error(reason) do safe_reason = reason |> to_string() |> sanitize_for_html() {:error, "
Authentication failed: #{safe_reason}
"} end defp sanitize_for_html(text) do text |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) end end
